question: Should this PR merge with read-scoped health recomputing a fresh live-vs-disk runtime-config summary for model/provider/auth drift on cache hits?
rationale: The code appears correct, but the merge tradeoff is an owner decision because it adds disk config reads to a health cache path and surfaces auth/provider drift state to least-privilege health callers while keeping details admin-only.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic As Scoped
options.body: Merge this shape if maintainers accept the disk-read cost and the admin-only detail gate as the right health contract.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Require a rate-limited or cheaper recompute path, or reduce auth/secrets drift visibility, if the health latency or visibility boundary is too broad.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic As Scoped
recommendation.body: Merge this shape if maintainers accept the disk-read cost and the admin-only detail gate as the right health contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the operator-facing health command contract and gateway status surface where this history shows repeated ownership.
